title: Repossession and Collateral Recovery Keyless Handling Charge for Agency Recoveries
content:
Agency handling term for a vehicle taken in without a key under Repossession and Collateral Recovery, as part of the agency recovery fee.

**Rule.** When no key was obtained at recovery, no key replacement fee expense is posted on the case and the class tow equipment is flatbed or medium-duty flatbed, a keyless handling charge of 95.00 is added; when no key was obtained, no key replacement fee expense is posted on the case and the class tow equipment is wheel-lift, a keyless handling charge of 65.00 is added; when a key was obtained or a key replacement fee expense is posted on the case, no keyless handling charge is added.

Class tow equipment: wheel-lift for Recovery Class 1 Passenger Car, Recovery Class 2 Minivan and Crossover and Recovery Class 3 Sport Utility Vehicle; flatbed for Recovery Class 4 Light-Duty Pickup and Recovery Class 5 Heavy-Duty Pickup; medium-duty flatbed for Recovery Class 6 Full-Size Van.

## Condition table

| Key obtained at recovery | Key replacement fee expense posted on the case | Class tow equipment | Keyless handling charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| no | no | flatbed or medium-duty flatbed | 95.00 |
| no | no | wheel-lift | 65.00 |
| no | yes | any | none |
| yes | no | any | none |
| yes | yes | any | none |

## Points of judgement

- The key fact is the case record of whether a key came in with the vehicle.
- A key replacement fee expense posted on the case, for cutting and programming a key, takes the case out of the charge whatever the equipment.
